We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Account Executive (Italian-speaking) (m/f/d) Your Role

As an Account Executive at fonio, you're a closer through and through. You get warm, pre-qualified leads every day and know exactly what to do with them. And when the pipeline dries out, you don't wait around: you go on the hunt for deals.

What to expect

 * Inbound demos: 8-16 qualified demo calls per day

 * Quota ownership: clear monthly and quarterly targets

 * Pipeline management: structured follow-ups and clean CRM hygiene

 * Help sharpen our sales motion as we scale fast

Who We're Looking For

 * 1+ years of sales experience in transactional or B2B SaaS sales

 * Proven closing track record along a structured funnel

 * High discipline, strong ownership, and a genuine hunger to earn

 * Natural communicator and storyteller

 * Native or C2 Italian; strong English. German is a big plus.

 * Ready for a paid temporary relocation (around 2 months in Vienna to soak up our culture)

What We Offer

 * €70.000-€100.000 OTE (base + uncapped commission)

 * Equity - you build it, you should own a piece of it.

 * Unlimited budget with the right ROI

 * Food & drinks - at our Vienna office, lunch and dinner are on us (plus all the drinks your heart desires, and yes, we have protein bars and vitamins too).

 * Relocation bonus (in case you want to stay in Vienna)

 * Equipment of your choice - whatever makes you happy.

 * Regular team offsites.

Hiring Process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 45 min skill interview with our CCO Alex, including a demo simulation

 * 30 min chat to get to know the go-to-market manager

 * 20 min culture call with our Founders

1 Postdoctoral Researcher (Quantitative Methods) (m/f/d) Advertisement No. SB26-0125.

Full-time position (40 hours/week), initially limited to two years.

In this position you will

 * Survey leadership
 ** Design and implement online surveys and embedded survey experiments (e.g. vignette and conjoint experiments) in LimeSurvey.
 ** Lead questionnaire development in close consultation with the Principal Investigator (PI).
 ** Coordinate survey implementation across Tunisia, Egypt, and Morocco, including social media-based participant recruitment.
 ** Lead the analysis of survey and experimental data using advanced quantitative methods.
 * Data collection
 ** Oversee the implementation of face-to-face survey in cooperation with a survey company in Morocco.
 ** Ensure high standards of data quality, research ethics compliance and data management throughout the data collection process.
 ** Contribute to and co-manage the coding of de facto (forced) migration policy data.
 * Research
 ** Develop and submit at least two articles to leading international peer-reviewed journals based on the survey data, in co-authorship with the PI.
 ** Contribute to theoretical development within the project and to further publications arising from MixedRivals.
 * Collaboration
 ** Present project findings at international conferences, workshops and other academic events.
 ** Contribute actively to project meetings, workshops, project documentation and grant reporting.
 ** Collaborate closely with an interdisciplinary and international research team.

Your profile

For your application, we require evidence of the following qualifications:

 * Completed PhD in political science, conflict studies, social psychology, or a related social science discipline, preferably with distinction (the PhD degree must be awarded at the latest by 15th of December 2026).
 * Advanced expertise in quantitative methods, including inferential statistics and causal inference.
 * Demonstrated experience in the design, implementation and analysis of online surveys and survey experiments, combined with advanced quantitative skills in R and/or Stata.
 * A strong publication record in international peer-reviewed journals, appropriate to career stage, together with excellent analytical and academic writing skills.
 * Excellent command of English (minimum C1), both written and spoken.
 * Strong organizational, interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an international research team.
 * Willingness to relocate to Austria and work regularly on site at Campus Krems.

In addition, the following criteria are desirable:
 * Previous research on inter-group perceptions, inequalities, (forced) migration and/or violence
 * Knowledge of or experience in North Africa, particularly Morocco
 * Knowledge of de facto migration policies in Africa
 * Experience with LimeSurvey or comparable survey software.
 * Knowledge of qualitative research methods (e.g. interviews) and/or qualitative analysis software such as MAXQDA
 * Programming skills (e.g. Python)
 * Knowledge of French and/or Arabic
 * Previous experience working in international collaborative research projects

We look forward to receiving your compelling online application by 7 October 2026.

The following documents must be submitted:

 * Curriculum Vitae, including publication list and contact details for two or three references
 * Motivation letter clearly explaining how you could contribute to the project tasks and how the position fits with your previous and future research agenda
 * Two writing samples, preferably first-authored peer-reviewed publications or single-authored academic work 
 * A brief description of your previous survey research experience, including the surveys and/or datasets you have worked with and your role in their design, implementation and/or analysis
 * Copies of degrees and transcripts

As a Motion Designer at fonio, you own the entire production pipeline for video content, from pre-production through animation to post-production including sound design. You do all of this yourself.

You work closely with our marketing team: the Creative Strategist provides concept and brief, the Content Creator shoots footage, and you turn that into animated, edited, and sound-ready final products that perform on Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and our website.

You take full ownership of the motion workflow end-to-end. We are deliberately not looking for a pure animation role that hands off to post-production. We want someone who understands that a great product video is half about sound.

Your Responsibilitites

 * Pre-production: concept sketches, storyboards, asset creation (vector graphics, visuals, UI mockups, screen recordings)
 * Animation: motion graphics for paid social (Meta, TikTok, YouTube), website, product showcases, tutorials, and internal formats
 * Post-production: video editing, cutting, pacing, color, transitions
 * Sound design: appropriate sounds, sound effects, music selection, mixing. You understand that sound is what brings product videos to life
 * Executing creative briefs, turning concepts into finished, performance-ready videos
 * Iterating based on performance data: what works, what doesn't, and why
 * Building a reusable motion asset library (templates, components, brand elements)

What to expect

 * Full ownership over all of fonio's motion output, end-to-end, no handoffs
 * Direct impact on an ad spend budget of over €700,000/month
 * Close collaboration with the Creative Strategist, Content Creator, and Marketing Lead
 * Short decision-making paths, fast pace, real autonomy
 * Access to the latest AI tools for motion (Runway, Sora, Kling, etc.)

Who We're Looking For

Must-haves:

 * 1-3 years of experience in motion design and animation
 * Native in After Effects. There is no motion design without AE, and you work in it faster than most people work in PowerPoint
 * Strong skills in a video editing tool (Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or comparable)
 * Command of the full production pipeline: pre-production (asset creation, concepting), animation, post-production (editing, color, sound design), all in one person
 * Sound design understanding. You know that a great product video is half about sound and can use effects and music to bring videos to life
 * Solid grasp of motion graphics animation principles (timing, easing, anticipation, weight)
 * Portfolio featuring digital and software product videos. We want to see that you can tell UI stories through motion
 * Fluent English, German at C1 level

Nice-to-have:

 * Experience with Cinema 4D, Figma, or other design and 3D tools
 * Experience with AI video tools (Runway, Sora, Kling, etc.)
 * Background in performance creative environments (B2B SaaS, DTC, etc.)

What We Offer

 * €65,000-100,000 gross annual salary (depending on experience)

 * Top equipment and access to the latest AI tools
 * Direct collaboration with founders and a strong marketing team
 * A product that scales, and creatives you'll actually see live and track the performance of

1 Junior Scientists (f/m/d) for 6G Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC) - JOB ID: 269373  * You will develop and validate numerical signal processing algorithms for mobile 5G/6G ISAC scenarios using simulations and measurements from an SDR testbed combining RF, fiber optic, and quantum sensing.
 * Depending on your background, you will conduct algorithm research and contribute to real-time experiments using SDR hardware and reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS).

 * Together with experienced colleagues, you will engage in establishing a unique 6G distributed MIMO sensing testbed based on SDR technology using open-source tools such as GNU Radio, RFNoC and LabVIEW for real-time FPGA algorithm design operating from 0.4 - 20 GHz.

 * You will learn how to evaluate the results and prepare them for further studies.
 * You will publish your research results in international journals and present them at conferences.
 * You will accumulate experience in a research field, that has an enormous range of applications from construction, logistics, aviation and railways to agriculture, robotics and defense.
 * You will gain experience in a group of international scientists and build up your professional network within European wide research projects.

Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner:

 * Completed technical studies (at least MSc.) related to Telecommunications, Computer Science or Electrical Engineering
 * First experience in at least one of the following areas: (i) multi-static MIMO UAV sensing, (ii) quantum sensing with NV centers and Rydberg cells, (iii) multimodal sensing with fiber optic and distributed RF sensors, or (iv) ISAC using reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS) and two-way ranging. Candidates should indicate in their cover letter how their background and interests align with one of these profiles (i-iv) and provide evidence of relevant expertise. Applications not addressing this point may not be considered.
